reason.finding: The initial replay conditioned eligibility/ranking on next-month price availability before fixing the top-20 portfolio.
reason.why_invalid: Forward-outcome availability can influence selection. A stock with no next-month price can be removed and replaced by rank 21, introducing selection bias/look-ahead through the outcome availability mask.
reason.required_rule: Calculate scores and freeze the selected top 20 using formation-date signal fields only. Check next-calendar-month outcomes afterwards. If any selected outcome is missing, mark the month and run incomplete; never substitute the next-ranked name.
reason.action: The run was marked FAILED in Supabase. The 57 monthly rows remain as audit history and must not be used for ranking, metrics or promotion.

strict_replacement.reason: Strict replay preserved F&D in the chosen portfolio and failed closed when the next-calendar-month adjusted close was missing. No rank-21 substitute was used.

limitations: Five of eight candidates have a missing selected F&D outcome for formation month 2026-08.
Three candidates are complete over the observed return horizon, but none passes the full PIT/data-integrity and prospective-validation gates.
The 925-symbol universe is survivor-oriented; point-in-time SET/mai membership and delisted/terminal price history remain unverified.
No formula from this family is approved for real-money execution.

preservation_rule: Do not delete the invalidated rows or rewrite the old formula as if it had never existed. Preserve the original artifact and run, mark the invalidation as a separate append-only audit record, and use only the strict replacement for any future rerun.
